title: Get_Attribute_Single with attribute path
purpose: Cover a deeper Message Router path using class, instance, and attribute style addressing with a documented read-like CIP common service.
expected_behavior: The parser should accept the frame and CPF items and then reach CIP dispatch for a Get_Attribute_Single request with an attribute-bearing path.
constraints_preserved: Length field 0x001a matches the 26 bytes of command-specific data.
The command-specific prefix precedes CPF as required for SendRRData.
CPF item order and little-endian item headers are preserved.
Unconnected Data Item length 10 matches the embedded CIP request.
Service code 0x0e is the documented Get_Attribute_Single service.
Path-size byte 0x03 matches three 16-bit path words.
issue_safety_notes: This is a normal valid read-style request shape, not an error-oriented payload.
